description:
After handled execution outcome persistence, serialize synchronization against new requests:

1. Capture the latest completed runtime context and a consistent history delta through D.
2. Merge by canonical references, retaining valid execution exchanges and respecting failed-runtime disposal policy.
3. Apply context while idle through Jido's existing `ai.react.context.modify` mechanism, using an operation ID and exact runtime incarnation.
4. Advance the stored cursor to D only once context application is confirmed.
5. Release admission for the next request. Associations committed after D remain future deltas.

Jido context replacement during an active run is deferred until terminalization and stores only one pending operation. Do not submit stale replacement snapshots mid-run. Acknowledgment of a queued operation is not confirmation it was applied.

If synchronization fails, preserve the old cursor or invalidate/rebuild the runtime. Never advance the cursor independently of its corresponding context. Scope this to in-memory lifecycle consistency; process-crash durability remains separate.

Prerequisites: fixed-cursor transformer integration. Files: Factory/ServerManager/Executor lifecycle and Jido contract integration tests. Action reuse: existing Jido ai.react.context.modify at idle boundary, acknowledged exact incarnation; no mid-run replacement queue. Tests first: context applied before cursor advance, simultaneous new request serialized, delta through D only, A/B reread dedupe, stale runtime PID, failed application and failed-run disposal. Mocking: external LLM; actual Jido runtime. Documentation: Agent runtime/context contract.

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.
title: [zaq-emb.16] Request-boundary context and cursor synchronization
